metadata.description: Region for every resource in this sample. The AIGateway SKU is a release-gated preview available only in East US 2 / Sweden Central, and its outbound integration needs a co-regional VNet, so the whole sample deploys in one of these regions.
Base name for the AI Services (Foundry) account. A short unique suffix is appended.
Name for your project resource (base name; a short unique suffix is appended).

projectDescription.defaultValue: A project for the AI Foundry account with network secured deployed Agent

metadata.description: Description applied to the project.
Display name for the project.
Model to deploy. The consumer account and the private hub both deploy this model; the gateway imports the hub deployment and callers reference it by this name.
Model format. Example: OpenAI.
Model version. Ensure this version is available in your region.
Model deployment SKU name. Example: GlobalStandard.
Model deployment capacity in thousands of TPM. Set a value your subscription has quota for.
Virtual Network name (created new, or the name of an existing VNet when existingVnetResourceId is set).
Name of the agent delegated subnet.
Name of the private-endpoint subnet.
Resource ID of an EXISTING Virtual Network to reuse. Leave empty to create a new VNet.
Address space for the VNet (only used for a new VNet).
Address prefix for the agent subnet (only used for a new VNet).
Address prefix for the private endpoint subnet (only used for a new VNet).
The AI Search Service full ARM Resource ID. Optional; if empty the resource is created.
The AI Storage Account full ARM Resource ID. Optional; if empty the resource is created.
The Cosmos DB Account full ARM Resource ID. Optional; if empty the resource is created.

The API Management Service full ARM Resource ID. Optional; only used to secure an existing API Management with a private endpoint. Leave empty for this sample (the AI Gateway tier instance below is created separately).
Object mapping DNS zone names to their resource group, or empty string to indicate creation.
Zone names for validation of existing Private DNS zones.
The name of the project capability host to be created.
Name for the outbound integration subnet added to the VNet for the AI Gateway tier.
CIDR for the outbound integration subnet. Must be a free /27 (or larger) inside the VNet address space. The default VNet uses 192.168.0.0/24 and 192.168.1.0/24, so 192.168.2.0/27 is free by default.
Base name for the private hub Foundry account (the model backend behind the gateway). A short unique suffix is appended.
Globally unique AI Gateway name. Resolves to <name>.azure-api.net. Leave empty to auto-generate.
Publisher email required by the API Management service at create time.
Publisher organization name required by the API Management service at create time.
Tokens-per-minute budget enforced on the model by the gateway token-limit policy (per caller identity). Low by default so the token-limit policy is easy to test (visible HTTP 429 throttling).
Connection name. Callers reference the model as <connectionName>/<modelName>.
HTTP header the connection uses to send the gateway key. The AI Gateway tier authenticates the api-key header.
If true, the connection is visible to every project on the account and appears in the Foundry portal "Admin-connected models" picker.
